# Intake Brief: Enable Main Street Expansion of Playing Area

## Problem Statement

Main Street currently has a single fixed 2×5 street (10 slots) with no ability to expand the playing field. The player should be able to zoom out at any time to reveal a larger 2D grid of streets, where each cell is a 2×5 street. Corner slots between streets are shared — one card serves all four adjacent streets, with normal adjacency rules.

## Users & User Stories

- **As a player**, I want to zoom out and explore neighbouring streets so that I can place more businesses and grow my empire beyond the initial 10-slot grid.
- **As a player**, I want shared corner plots between streets so that strategically placed businesses create cross-street synergy bonuses.
- **As a player**, I want the zoom to work like a map — smooth camera movement that reveals streets organically without gating or milestones.
- **As a game engine developer**, I want the grid system to be unbounded (or at least large enough to support extended play) so the game doesn't end prematurely when all streets are full.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Camera system**: A zoom/pan camera system is implemented for Main Street, allowing the player to zoom out to reveal neighbouring streets. The zoom is controlled by the player (e.g. scroll wheel or button), not gated by milestones.
2. **Grid topology**: The street grid is represented as a 2D lattice where each cell is a 2×5 street. Corner slots (where streets meet at the corners of adjacent 2×5 grids) are shared — one card slot serves the shared position, and the card is adjacent to neighbours in all four streets per normal adjacency rules.
3. **Adjacency & synergy**: The adjacency resolver (`MainStreetAdjacency.ts`) is updated to compute correct 8-way Chebyshev adjacency across street cells, including shared corner slots. Synergy bonuses and income calculations work correctly for cards on expanded streets and shared corners.
4. **Rendering**: All street cells within the current camera viewport are rendered. Cards placed on expanded or shared slots display and interact correctly. Unrevealed streets outside the current zoom level are not rendered.
5. **Save/Load**: The expanded grid state (all placed cards, including shared corner cards, and current zoom/camera position) serializes and deserializes correctly.

## Constraints

- The zoom is **always available** — no gating by milestones, turns, or resources.
- The grid is **conceptually unbounded** (at minimum, support at least a 3×3 or 5×5 grid of streets). Practically, the grid could grow dynamically as the player zooms out further.
- Corner plots are **shared between streets**: one card slot, one card, normal adjacency rules (8-way Chebyshev) apply — the card counts as a neighbour to all adjacent slots across all streets it touches.
- The existing `GRID_SIZE = 10`, `STREET_COLS = 5`, `STREET_ROWS = 2` constants and the flat 10-slot array must be refactored to support multi-street topology.
- Must preserve deterministic seed-based gameplay and save/load compatibility.
- Existing adjacency/synergy/Income systems must continue working without modification to core logic — only the coordinate/adjacency mapping layer changes.

## Existing State

- **Single street**: `GRID_SIZE = 10`, `STREET_COLS = 5`, `STREET_ROWS = 2` (from `MainStreetConstants.ts` and `MainStreetCards.ts`).
- **Flat array**: `streetGrid` is `(BusinessCard | CommunitySpaceCard | null)[]` with row-major indexing.
- **Adjacency**: `MainStreetAdjacency.ts` — `toGridPosition()` maps flat index → {x, y} using `STREET_COLS = 5`; `neighbors()` computes 8-way Chebyshev distance within the 10-slot boundary.
- **Rendering**: `MainStreetRenderer.ts` and `MainStreetLayoutAdapter.ts` position 10 slots in two rows, hardcoded layout.
- **No camera system**: Phaser camera is not used for street navigation; the game uses a fixed viewport.
- **SpatialRules**: Core engine provides `Grid<T>`, `neighbors()`, `shortestPath()` (`@core-engine/SpatialRules`) — reusable for multi-street topology.

## Desired Change

- Introduce a 2D street-cell grid where each cell is a 2×5 street (10 slots).
- Add a camera/zoom system to navigate the grid.
- Refactor the adjacency resolver to work with the 2D grid, computing correct neighbours across street cells and shared corners.
- Update rendering to draw all visible street cells within the viewport.
- Update state serialization to include the full grid and camera position.

## Key Files (Predicted)

- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetConstants.ts` — Refactor `STREET_COLS/ROWS` into per-street-cell dimensions; add grid dimension constants.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCards.ts` — Update `GRID_SIZE` to a dynamic value; remove hard-coded 10-slot assumption.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts` — Change `streetGrid` from flat array to 2D grid structure; add camera/zoom state.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetAdjacency.ts` — Refactor `toGridPosition()`, `neighbors()` to compute positions on the 2D street-cell grid; handle shared corner slots.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRenderer.ts` — Update rendering loop to iterate over visible street cells; add camera transform.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetLayoutAdapter.ts` — Update layout calculations for multi-street grid.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts` — Integrate camera control (zoom/pan input), wire up rendering and adjacency changes.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetTurnController.ts` — Update drop-zone and click-target logic for expanded grid.

## Related Work

- **CG-0MM4RDIMT1HLP2DE**: Main Street GDD Review and Consolidation (parent epic)
- **CG-0MM5ZG7071KO7PVG**: Adjacency & Spatial Rules (core engine spatial system)
- **CG-0MQKA533D003P55Y**: Gym: SpatialRules demo scene (Grid + pathfinding)
- **CG-0MM4RG1GM0SRVENC**: Main Street PRD Milestone 6 — Engine Component Extraction
- **CG-0MM4R9UJF1DGI0ZF**: Main Street (parent epic)
- **CG-0MPENWRBO0051ZQT**: Port Main Street to SLL (UI layout modernisation)
- **CG-0MT5Y1X5T001M4S6**: This item — Enable Main Street expansion of playing area

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers

- **Q1**: What triggers the grid expansion? — **A**: No gating — player can zoom out at any time. Source: interactive reply.
- **Q2**: How does "zoom" work visually and mechanically? — **A**: Like a map — camera zoom reveals pre-defined streets on a larger 2D grid. Source: interactive reply.
- **Q3**: What does "corner plots shared with each edge" mean for gameplay? — **A**: Yes, shared corner slot counts as adjacent to neighbours in both streets. One card slot, one card, normal adjacency rules apply. Source: interactive reply.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **CG-0MQU3AREL0099R1I** – Main Street refined layout: column-based right panel, wider market/street (completed)
- **CG-0MLVOTXVS1IEK03X** – Migrate GolfScene layout to 1280x720 (completed)
- **CG-0MO4LWWQY008SWRK** – Thumbnail: canonical fixture + automated generation (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — matched: ability, able, add, allowing, always (+184 more)
- `AGENTS.md` — matched: ability, able, acceptance, add, adjacency (+159 more)
- `docs/main-street/prd-milestone-2.md` — matched: 0mm4rdimt1hlp2de, ability, able, acceptance, add (+156 more)

## Problem

Every Main Street card has a 64x64 art zone (at 8,8) containing a base64-encoded PNG sprite. When the card SVG is rasterised by Phaser at 4x quality scale, the 64x64 bitmap is upscaled 4x to fill a 256x256 device-pixel region, producing visible pixelation.

The 1024x1024 source sprites already exist in `example-games/main-street/sprites/<Name>_1024_x_1024.png` (commit 05026750, ~54 MB total). These are the original source art. Currently only `_64_x_64.png` files are used.

## Solution

1. Regenerate `scripts/generate-main-street-card-art.mjs` to read `_1024_x_1024.png` source files and encode the embedded PNG at 256x256 (downsampled from 1024, with 256-colour palette encoding).
2. Regenerate `example-games/main-street/card-art-map.json` and all `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/*.svg` files.
3. Keep `GRAPHIC_W/H = 64` in the SVG layout (the art zone stays 64x64 CSS pixels, the higher-resolution bitmap is simply downsampled crisply during rasterisation).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. All 63 `sprites/<Name>_1024_x_1024.png` files are used as sources (not `_64_x_64.png`)
2. Embedded PNGs in `card-art-map.json` are 256x256 (verified by parsing data URI and checking decoded dimensions)
3. All SVGs in `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/*.svg` embed the 256x256 art
4. Unit tests pass (`npm test -- --project unit`)
5. Build succeeds (`npm run build`)
6. Visual verification: card art zone is no longer pixelated at 1x, 2x, and 3x viewport scale

## Files to modify

- `scripts/generate-main-street-card-art.mjs` - source suffix, encoding dimensions
- `example-games/main-street/card-art-map.json` - regenerated
- `public/assets/games/main-street/svg/cards/*.svg` - regenerated via SVG generator
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCardArt.ts` - CARD_ART_SIZE stays 64 (unchanged)
- `tests/main-street/card-art.test.ts` - update test expectations if any
data.title: Raise embedded card-art sprite resolution from 64x64 to 256x256

CG-0MT5Y1X5T001M4S6: City-block grid with roads — producer feedback implemented (commit cf457b9b, pushed to dev).

## What the producer asked for
Streets in a grid **with gaps**, like a city block grid: a road between each row of plots, roads drawn as grey rectangles with a dotted white line down the middle, the pattern growing as the camera zooms out. Q2 = "see 1"; Q3 = no backward compatibility needed.

## What changed

**Topology — shared seams removed.** The lattice no longer shares a street's touching column/row with its neighbour. Each street **owns its own ten plots** and streets are tiled at a stride of exactly `(STREET_COLS, STREET_ROWS) = (5, 2)`, so the board is a real grid of separate streets instead of one solid block. `worldSlotCount` is now `(5·cols) × (2·rows)`: **10 / 20 / 20 / 40 / 60 / 90** for 1×1, 2×1, 1×2, 2×2, 3×2, 3×3 (was 10/18/15/27/39/52). The shared-seam node model (`worldOwners`, shared-corner indices, the DSU history) was **deleted**, not kept behind a flag — per Q3 there is no save migration, so saves written by the shared-seam build are not loadable.
- Geometry now has a single source of truth in `MainStreetCardsConstants` (`WORLD_STRIDE_X/Y`, `worldWidth`, `worldHeight`, `worldSlotCount`), re-exported by `MainStreetCards` and `MainStreetAdjacency`; `MainStreetState.setStreetGridLattice` re-indexes with the same helpers.
- **Cross-street adjacency is preserved**: the world set is still a contiguous rectangle, so 8-way Chebyshev adjacency reaches across a street boundary — the plot on one street's edge is adjacent to the neighbouring street's edge plot. Cross-street synergy/income therefore still work (verified by new contract fixtures).

**Roads.** A road band is drawn between every pair of adjacent streets plus around the outside (`MainStreetMapView.mapRoadBands`), as grey rectangles (`ROAD_COLOUR = 0x4a4a4a`) with a **dashed white centre line** (`ROAD_MARKING_COLOUR`, `ROAD_MARKING_WIDTH`, `ROAD_DASH_PERIOD`/`ROAD_DASH_LENGTH`), sized `ROAD_BAND_X_RATIO`/`ROAD_BAND_Y_RATIO` of the plot pitch. `MainStreetRenderer.drawStreetRoads()` draws them into the camera-transformed street layer, so they zoom/pan/clip with the map. Roads are decoration only — they never occupy a world slot and never affect adjacency, income or synergy. The road grid grows with the lattice as the camera zooms out.

**Zoom growth** is unchanged from the previous commit: zoom level N grows the displayed lattice to `(2N−1)×(2N−1)` streets, and a restored camera re-grows it.

## Tests
- New `tests/main-street/street-roads.test.ts` (headless): street blocks separated by a road band, `cols+1` vertical / `rows+1` horizontal bands, bands never overlap a plot, bands stay inside `mapBounds`, band count grows with the lattice.
- New browser test: the road layer exists, its band count tracks the displayed lattice, and — by sampling the real canvas — the road **surface is grey** and a **bright dashed centre line** is drawn on it.
- New browser test: zooming out from the default 1×1 board reveals new street cells (regression guard from the earlier audit).
- Contract/edge-case/viewport/map-view/save-load tests rewritten for the city-block model (20/40/90 plot counts, per-street ownership, cross-street corner fixtures, road-aware pan clamping).
- Fixed two tests that counted street-container `Graphics` objects (the road layer is now one of them): `synergy-formation` and `expanded-viewport`.

## Verification
- `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` green.
- Unit: 382 files / 6718 tests pass. Browser: 114 files / 659 tests pass.
- **Full suite via the test skill at the committed state cf457b9b: success** (unit + browser + tutorial E2E, failures: []). Cache populated (scope full, exit 0) so the audit can auto-verify execution-dependent ACs.
- Two pre-existing contention flakes (`day-banner`, `HelpPanelLayering`) appeared once under a loaded full-suite run and passed on isolated and subsequent full runs — same class as CG-0MU0IV260002GHD7 / CG-0MU0RKGRC009Q1E6.

## Interpretation to confirm (non-blocking)
The sketch's rows like `RP   PRP   PRP   PR` have blank middle cells. I read those as the space between/around street blocks and implemented every street as a full **2×5 = 10-plot** block (per the intake's street definition), with roads between blocks. If the blanks were meant to be genuinely non-placeable courtyard cells (i.e. fewer than 10 plots per street), that is a follow-up change to `MainStreetCardsConstants` + the adjacency model.

## Notes
- At 1× the default game is a single street, so there is no road between streets and the outer ring falls outside the clipped street band (the street sits at `streetX = 20`, less than one road band from the canvas edge). Roads appear as soon as neighbouring streets are revealed by zooming out. Making a perimeter road visible at 1× would need an SLL layout change to move the street inboard.
- Docs updated: `docs/main-street/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` (city-block grid, `worldSlotCount` table, road layer, history note).

Implementation complete in worktree wl-CG-0MUCM36EQ008YP4R-raise-embedded-card-art-sprite-resolutio.

## What changed
- Embedded card-art bitmap raised from 64x64 PNG to 256x256 WebP (downscaled from the committed 1024x1024 sources). The 64x64 art zone is a layout dimension in SVG user units, not the render resolution: rasteriseSvgToTexture uses qualityScale = Math.max(4, dpr), so the zone occupies up to 256x256 device pixels and the old 64x64 bitmap was stretched 4x.
- WebP rather than PNG because 256x256 PNG costs ~5.3 MB of base64 across all 63 sprites (would more than double the app bundle); WebP quality 90 costs ~0.6 MB, i.e. ~2x the old 64x64 PNG map while carrying 16x the pixels. Bundle delta measured: +279 KB.
- card-art-map.json bumped to version 2 with artResolution/format fields; MainStreetCardArt.ts exports CARD_ART_RESOLUTION and CARD_ART_FORMAT.
- Tests: per-sprite 256x256 WebP decode assertions (drift guard now uses the 1024x1024 sources) + a new browser test proving the embedded WebP actually rasterises into the art zone (with-art vs no-art mean-absolute-difference 44/255 vs a 20 threshold).
- Docs: CREDITS.md, card-dimensions.md, DEVELOPER.md.

## Verification
- npm run build: green (bundle 3.15 MB -> 3.43 MB; +279 KB)
- npm run test:smoke: 109/109 green
- Unit tests: tests/main-street/ 202 files / 3410 tests green
- Browser tests: tests/main-street/ 49 files / 273 tests green on a clean run

## Known pre-existing flake (not caused by this change)
The full-suite browser gate is flaky under parallel load (CG-0MU0IV260002GHD7: Phaser 4 CanvasPool GPU-context exhaustion). Observed across runs: HelpPanelLayering / upgrade-drag-drop / day-banner fail intermittently and pass in isolation and on a clean re-run. Verified non-deterministic: three consecutive runs of tests/main-street/ produced {HelpPanelLayering+day-banner FAIL}, {HelpPanelLayering+upgrade-drag-drop FAIL}, {PASS 49/49}. The failures are in the documented flake family, not in the changed area.
